title: A. Exponential Equation
statement:
You are given an integer n.

Find any pair of integers (x,y) (1≤ x,y≤ n) such that x^y·y+y^x·x = n.

The first line contains a single integer t (1≤ t≤ 10^4) — the number of test cases.

Each test case contains one line with a single integer n (1≤ n≤ 10^9).

For each test case, if possible, print two integers x and y (1≤ x,y≤ n). If there are multiple answers, print any.

Otherwise, print -1.

In the third test case, 2^3·3+3^2·2 = 42, so (2,3),(3,2) will be considered as legal solutions.

In the fourth test case, 5^5·5+5^5·5 = 31250, so (5,5) is a legal solution.

Input:
```
537423125020732790
```

Output:
```
-1
-1
2 3
5 5
3 13
```
